verdict.rationale: Polar documents a dedicated sandbox server that is fully isolated from production. It supports unlimited test accounts and organizations, end-to-end checkout with Stripe test cards, and no real money processing. For AI-native use, it also publishes a separate sandbox MCP endpoint (`mcp.polar.sh/mcp/polar-sandbox`) so agents can work against test data rather than live data. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the sandbox and sandbox MCP behave as documented.
